en.무한 모드: 조각을 끌어 놓아 가로·세로 줄을 채우면 지워져요. 세 조각: Endless: drag pieces onto the board; full rows and columns clear. Use all three to get new ones; the game ends when nothing fits. Clear again within 3 moves to keep a combo going for bigger scores.
en.두뇌 도전은 화면 아래 '두뇌 도전 · 추가 도전'에 있어요. 정해진 조: Brain Challenge is under 'Brain Challenge · More' below the board: 100 stages of clearing target lines with set pieces. Hints, undos and restarts share one count across all games.
en.미션 한 판: 조각을 끌어 놓아 가로·세로 줄을 채우면 지워져요. 큰 조: Missions: drag pieces in; full rows and columns clear. Fit the big pieces well and several lines burst at once. Reach the badge or line goal to win; run out of room and it's over. Each opening board is built so the first three pieces fit just right.
en.두뇌 도전: 정해진 조각만으로 목표 줄 수를 지우는 100단계 퍼즐이에요: Brain Challenge: 100 puzzle stages — clear the target lines using only the given pieces. Think about order and placement. Replay cleared stages from your records.
en.무한 모드: 끝없이 이어지는 판에서 최고 점수를 노려요. 힌트·되돌리기·: Endless: an endless board — go for a high score. Hints, undos and restarts share one count across all games.
